channel: Claude Code session, structured question answers
owner_request_verbatim: let's start one at a time. with the direct booking practice. audit it against the decision log and the skill's precedent index. i want to take this opportunity to build the full episode from scratch and test the pipeline to see if it can work on it's own after the audio is finalized

questions_and_answers.question: Which look should EP009 be built in?
questions_and_answers.option_text: Filmed people, your V5 avatar, rough pencil models, evidence cards with interest notes. New EP009 world (inn, front desk, guest book).

questions_and_answers.question: How much can the test spend without asking you per take?
questions_and_answers.option_text: Up to 2,000 Higgsfield credits and $40 Fal/Kling for EP009. Stops and asks if it would exceed the cap.

questions_and_answers.question: What should the test do in place of your scene-by-scene locks?
questions_and_answers.option_text: An agent reviewer checks each scene against the precedents and records its verdict; you review the finished full cut once.
